entries.note: A full real run completed on 2026-09-13: 26 agents, 3,905 reasons, about 7 minutes, proving the pipeline end to end.
A 3x3x3 smoke preset and subset dispatch make trial runs cheap instead of requiring the full 26-agent cost.
Explains v0.1.0 design-first ordering; the real run has since happened and testing gaps are covered by IMP-11/IMP-18.
Directly addressed: init --preset smoke builds a 3-wide, 3-deep tree for cheap pipeline rehearsal.
Release-labeling psychology behind v0.1.0; nothing further to change beyond the proof run and tests already covered.
Skill already caps messages at 20; plan-level dispatch waves under the concurrency cap make the full run predictable.
A non-blocking hygiene report flags duplicates, near-duplicates, parent restatements and over-length reasons beyond shape validation.
The implied model-based judge in the check loop is declined as flaky and costly; stdlib hygiene flags substitute.
Principle clarification separates allowed mechanical aids like hygiene flags from interpretation, which stays with the user.
Hygiene report defines concrete mechanical criteria (duplicates, restatements, length) as the enforceable specification absent a semantic rubric.
Near-duplicate detection uses stdlib token overlap discounting ancestor words, avoiding embeddings (R-02) while still catching repeats.
README will state plainly what check validates and does not, so shape validity is not mistaken for analytical value.
Sibling-aware branch prompts list the other level-1/2 reasons as covered elsewhere, reducing cross-branch repetition.
Directly addressed: branch prompts gain the level-1/2 digest in addition to their own ancestor chain.
Sequential passes sharing deeper generated output are declined because they serialize the run; IMP-07 shares a cheap digest.
Legitimate recurrence should stay, but hygiene near-duplicate flags make recurring systemic causes visible without deleting anything.
The fixed eight-kind generic checklist is replaced with grounding in the problem's specifics and a specific-vs-generic example.
Outline-before-write and specificity grounding counter attention thinning across the 155 reasons each branch agent writes.
Navigation via show, an index.md of levels 1-2 and branch-by-branch paging make the large output usable without full loads.
Parameterized breadth and depth let users choose smaller complete trees instead of the fixed geometric 3,905-reason size.
assemble writes an index.md of levels 1-2; summary and pruning layers stay declined under R-01.
show subcommand exists; loading guidance will page branch by branch rather than assuming whole-file reads.
A plugin synthesis or ranking step is declined; the user's requirement leaves analysis of the reasons to the user.
Completeness is the user's explicit requirement; trees stay complete, though shape becomes configurable under IMP-01.
Shape is the core hard-coded element; parameterized breadth/depth stored in run.json starts turning the prototype into configurable engineering.
Directly addressed: plan, check, assemble and prompts read shape from run.json instead of BRANCHING/DEPTH module constants.
init --model records a model choice per run and passes it as the Agent override, with documented trade-offs.
An evals/ case runs a smoke-preset end to end, grading shape validity and hygiene presence despite nondeterministic content.
A stdlib unittest suite supplies the test discipline a reviewer or CI would have demanded; recruiting reviewers is R-06.
Building a benchmark dataset of known-good Five Whys trees is out of scope as a non-plugin activity.
